name: Figure AI

latestValuationSignal.note: The Information (Oct 7, 2026): Nvidia discussed investing another ~$1B as Figure seeks financing at ~$38B PRE-money (not comparable to the $39B post-money Series C). Not confirmed by either company as of Oct 21. Forbes (Oct 5, updated Oct 7) quoted board member Gregg Hill (Parkway) saying Figure is closing 'billions' as a Series C extension and that a Series D would be 'considerably higher'; company declined to confirm. Above the $20B threshold either way.

changes: No confirmation or close of the reported Nvidia ~$1B / ~$38B pre-money talks since Oct 9 (https://www.humanoidsdaily.com/news/nvidia-figure-billion-investment-talks-report).

Minor: Adcock posted on Oct 19 that a Figure 03 had walked 348 miles / 1.2M steps over 9 straight days on a treadmill. It was tethered to external power and no test protocol was published (https://interestingengineering.com/ai-robotics/figure-03-humanoid-robot-treadmill-test).
notes: Forbes profile (https://www.forbes.com/sites/annatong/2026/10/05/brett-adcock-sold-investors-a-humanoid-future-now-he-has-to-build-it/, pre-window) adds risk context: BMW says only one Figure robot worked at a time in the 2025 pilot; OpenAI cites Figure's 'consistent failure to meet the deliverables'; Midas-list investors questioned the valuation. The Inference (Oct 20) cites rentals at ~$1,000/robot/month, which is unverified. No revenue figure found. Could not verify the treadmill tweet ID via fxtwitter, so it is not cited as an xPost.
